usedFor: Botse receives customer messages, and Freshsales Classic opens a deal when “New Incoming Message” runs “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incoming Message” in Botse, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A customer who writes in gets a deal in Freshsales Classic, so no sales conversation goes untracked.

watchOut: “New Incoming Message” fires on every message, so one chatty customer can create several deals through “Create Deal”.
